title: Ashbury Rewards Points Commerce Price Schedule: Volume Prices per Thousand Points
content:
| Points bought in one purchase | Order price per 1000 points before tax |
|---|---|
| 50000 or more | 11.50 USD |
| 20000 to 49000 | 12.00 USD |
| Fewer than 20000 | No volume price under this schedule |

**Schedule note.** The order price — the price per thousand points of an Ashbury Rewards points purchase — is eleven US dollars and fifty cents per thousand points for a purchase of fifty thousand points or more, and twelve dollars for a purchase of twenty thousand to forty-nine thousand points. The size of the purchase is the points bought in that one purchase: for a member buying the most points they are allowed, the remaining purchase allowance — the purchase allowance less the points bought in the twelve months before the handling date, never below zero — rounded down to a multiple of the tier's points purchase increment. The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical purchases).**

| Points bought | Order price per 1000 points |
|---|---|
| 50000 | 11.50 USD |
| 49000 | 12.00 USD |
| 20000 | 12.00 USD |
| 19000 | No volume price |
